rust_summary: queueing one client world-entry, connection or leave request for the next frame (`native_request_open_world`, `native_request_connect`, `native_request_leave`).
doc_summary: `request_open_world(folder)` accepts a single saves-folder basename; `request_connect(address)` accepts a nonblank address. Both require idle Main, world-selection or multiplayer title menus with no active connection, player, integrated server or loading/saving work. `request_leave()` requires a loaded client world without a title menu, reconfiguration or pending work. One request may wait at a time; state is rechecked at the next frame start and stale requests are discarded. Execution uses open_world, connect_server_with_options or close_world, with existing prompts, save behavior and setup errors. False rejects without side effects. Requires native hooks API @API:client_session_requests@.
